data.description: Rows to display. Nested rows live in the children field; with parentKey set, pass one flat list instead.

rowKey.description: Field path or function returning a unique, stable key for each row.

childrenField.description: Field path holding child rows in nested data.

getChildren.description: Returns a row's children. Takes precedence over childrenField. Pass a stable (memoized) function.

parentKey.description: Builds the tree from a flat list: field path or function returning each row's parent key. Rows without a known parent become roots.

hasChildren.description: Declares whether a row can have children. Return false to hide the toggle on rows that loadChildren should not fetch.

loadChildren.type: (row: T, ctx: { offset: number; signal: AbortSignal }) => Promise<T[] | { rows: T[]; hasMore?: boolean }>
loadChildren.description: Lazily loads a row's children when it is first expanded. Return { rows, hasMore: true } to page large child lists; the next page loads automatically as it scrolls into view. Requests are aborted on unmount.

expandedKeys.description: Controlled set of expanded row keys.

defaultExpandAll.description: Expand every row that has children on first render.

defaultExpandLevel.description: Expand rows up to this depth on first render (1 expands the roots).

onExpandedChange.type: (keys: Set<Key>, event: { row: T | null; rowKey: Key | null; expanded: boolean }) => void
onExpandedChange.description: Called when rows expand or collapse. row is null for bulk operations.

expandOnRowClick.description: Toggle a parent row when the row is clicked.

expanderColumn.description: Key of the column that shows indentation and the expand toggle.

selectionMode.description: Row selection behavior. multiple supports Ctrl/Cmd and Shift clicks; checkbox renders tri-state checkboxes.

selectedKeys.description: Controlled set of selected row keys.

onSelectionChange.type: (keys: Set<Key>, event: { row: T | null; rowKey: Key | null; selected: boolean }) => void

propagateSelection.description: In checkbox mode, checking a row checks its descendants and parents show a mixed state.

showSelectAll.description: Show a select-all checkbox in the expander column header for multiple and checkbox modes.

isRowSelectable.description: Return false to prevent selecting a row.

isRowDisabled.description: Return true to disable a row: not selectable, editable or draggable.

sort.description: Controlled sort state: [{ key, direction: 'asc' | 'desc' }]. Siblings are sorted within their parent.

onSortChange.description: Called when a sortable header is activated.

multiSort.description: Shift, Ctrl or Cmd + click adds a column to the sort.

manualSort.description: Skip client-side sorting; sort the data yourself in onSortChange.

filterText.description: Global search text matched against every column with globalFilter not set to false.

filters.description: Controlled per-column filter values, keyed by column key.

onFiltersChange.description: Called when a filter row value changes.

showFilterRow.description: Render a filter input under each filterable column header.

filterMode.description: lenient keeps all descendants of a matching row; strict shows only matching rows. Ancestors of matches are always shown and expanded.

filterDebounce.description: Delay in ms before a filter row input applies.

manualFilter.description: Skip client-side filtering; filter the data yourself.

highlightMatches.description: Highlight filter matches in default-rendered cells.

size.description: Row density: 32, 40 or 48px rows. Touch devices use at least 44px.

rowHeight.description: Fixed row height in px, or a function for variable heights.

height.description: Height of the scroll viewport. Rows are virtualized inside it.

overscan.description: Extra rows rendered above and below the viewport.

showGuides.description: Draw tree guide lines connecting parents and children.

resizableColumns.description: Allow column resizing by dragging or with arrow keys on the header handle.

reorderableColumns.description: Allow reordering non-frozen columns by dragging headers or Alt + Shift + Arrow keys.

columnOrder.description: Controlled column order, as column keys.

rowReorder.description: Allow moving rows by drag and drop or Alt + Arrow keys. Update data in onRowMove.

canMoveRow.description: Return false to reject a move.

onRowMove.type: (event: { row; rowKey; target; targetKey; position: 'before' | 'after' | 'inside' }) => void
onRowMove.description: Called when a row is dropped or moved with the keyboard.

onCellEdit.type: (event: { row; rowKey; column; field; value; previousValue }) => void
onCellEdit.description: Called when an editable cell commits a new value. Required for editing.

rowIcon.type: (row: T, ctx: { expanded; hasChildren; level }) => ReactNode
rowIcon.description: Icon shown before the expander column content.

rowLabel.description: Accessible name used in toggle and checkbox labels.

onCellClick.type: (event: { row; rowKey; column; value }, nativeEvent: MouseEvent) => void

onEndReached.description: Called when the user scrolls near the last row and hasMore is true. Append the next page of root rows to data.

hasMore.description: More root rows are available for onEndReached.

loadingMore.description: Shows a loading row after the last row while the next page loads.

endReachedThreshold.description: How many rows before the end onEndReached fires.

loading.description: Show skeleton rows instead of data.

skeletonRows.description: Number of skeleton rows while loading.

emptyMessage.description: Content shown when there are no rows.

showFooter.default: true when any column defines footer

caption.description: Visible caption; also labels the grid.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label when there is no caption.

ariaLabelledBy.description: ID of an element that labels the grid.

ariaDescribedBy.description: ID of an element that describes the grid.

labels.description: Override any built-in text for localization.

className.description: Extra class names for the root element.

style.description: Inline styles for the root element.

key.description: Unique column key. Also the default field path.

field.description: Dot path of the value to display, e.g. 'owner.name'.

headerAriaLabel.description: Accessible header name when title is not plain text.

group.description: Group header label. Adjacent columns with the same group share one header cell.

width.description: Width in px, or a CSS track such as '2fr' or '25%'. Flexible by default.

frozen.description: Pin the column while scrolling horizontally.

hideBelow.description: Hide the column when the table is narrower than the breakpoint.

resizable.description: Set false to lock this column's width when resizableColumns is on.

reorderable.description: Set false to lock this column's position when reorderableColumns is on.

filterable.description: Show a text filter in the filter row.

filterFn.description: Custom filter test for this column.

globalFilter.description: Set false to exclude this column from filterText matching.

wrap.description: Wrap text instead of truncating with an ellipsis. Pair with a taller rowHeight.

showTitle.description: Set false to omit the native tooltip with the full cell text.

valueGetter.description: Computes the cell value. Used for display, sorting, filtering and export.

format.description: Formats the value as text for display, filtering and export.

aggregate.description: Rolls up leaf values into parent rows and the footer.

aggregateParents.description: Set false to keep parent rows' own values and only aggregate in the footer.

editable.description: Allow inline editing with double-click, Enter or F2.

validate.description: Return an error message to block the edit.

parseValue.description: Converts the default editor's text to a value.

className.description: Class for every cell in the column.

cell.description: Cell template. ctx has row, value, level, expanded, selected, aggregated, toggle() and more.

filter.type: (ctx: { column; value; onChange; placeholder; ariaLabel }) => ReactNode
filter.description: Custom filter control for the filter row.

editor.type: (ctx: { row; value; error; commit; cancel; ariaLabel }) => ReactNode

expandAll.description: Expand every row whose children are loaded.

expandToLevel.description: Expand rows above the given depth.

revealRow.description: Expand all ancestors of a row so it becomes visible.

scrollToRow.description: Scroll a visible row into view.

scrollToIndex.description: Scroll to a visible row index.

focusRow.description: Move keyboard focus to a visible row.

reloadChildren.description: Discard and reload a row's lazily loaded children.

getRow.description: Find a loaded row by key.

getVisibleRows.description: Rows currently in the expanded, filtered, sorted order.

selectAll.description: Select every selectable row that matches the filter.

toCsv.type: (options?: { allRows?; onlySelected?; includeHidden?; includeLevel?; levelHeader?; delimiter? }) => string
toCsv.description: Export rows as CSV text. Cells that could run as spreadsheet formulas are escaped.
